rationale: Harish–Chandra algebra-character/W-invariance and associated-character line convention now cite actual suppliers. All complex weights and fixed isotropy sheaf quotient remain; no generalized central action is silently substituted for exact quotient.

Native saturation via zero-labelled simple roots and own integral-subsystem simple roots is valid. Isolated proof addition explicitly undoes temporary Weyl conjugation before applying original antidominance and Q+; no claim that conjugation preserves that cone.

Exact extension by zero receives its actual ring-module action, preserves the support condition and satisfies module adjunction stalkwise. Injectives become flasque and ordinary/derived cohomology comparison supports consumer exactness.
Two-chart Laurent quotient directly gives all integer degree cases, including d=0 (H0=C), d=-1 (both zero), d<=-2 basis and no higher terms.
Principal sl2 height raising surjects n_j→n_(j+1); finite height elimination preserves lower coefficients. Nonzero simple coefficients characterize the B orbit, including explicit rank-zero case.

Finite standard affine cover clears denominators and overlap differences; finite subsums yield coherent subobjects. Finite Cech sums and exact filtered colimits justify cohomology passage; no coherence of M as a D-module is confused with O-coherence.

All frame generators, including isotropy, participate in the three PBW overlap types; isotropy elimination uses invariant character and zero anchor. Isolated proof replaces the reversed function-inversion measure with a valid lexicographic termination measure. Twist and all complex parameters preserved.

Native root brackets prove minimal-parabolic ideal and unipotent radical; codimension-two complement gives R1/S2 normality. Singleton geometric fibers plus proper quasi-finite and generic separable degree/discriminant give birationality; finite normal integral algebra gives global functions. Isolated fixes correct actual P1 projection, retagged constructibility fact, Killing/proper citation, and type group N_i image through polynomial log.

Actual product is established on the trivialized principal torsor Atiyah algebroid, then quotient by the correct character and PBW. Gauge derivatives and torsor cocycle support differential gluing, not just product schemes. Ordinary inverse image has O_P1 factor before rho shift.

All-weight exact central quotient and shifted character remain. Central finite-order fiber calculation and the injective graded-symbol map are compared with the full Springer pullback; intermediate graded maps become isomorphisms. No regularity/dominance or arbitrary partial-flag generalization inferred.
Right A action from the proved global TDO algebra defines sheaf tensor localization for every complex weight. Only right exactness and the subsequent adjunction are claimed before antidominance.

Uses actual B-stable finite representation-bundle filtration even when M lacks B action. Distinct central characters give generalized-character polynomial projectors for sheaves of complex vector spaces/U(g), not unjustified O-linear splittings. Both regular and singular branches retain their stated differences.
Free presentations ensure quasi-coherence; tensor-Hom and evaluation at1 give the adjunction for all parameters. It is not promoted to an equivalence at singular parameters.

Native new exactness Statement is justified by ordinary/derived comparison and R1 vanishing on full module sheaves. Coherent O-submodules are used only for Serre vanishing/generation and splitting is applied to M, avoiding invalid D-structure on those subobjects. Conservativity still requires both regularity and antidominance.

Now has exactly the explicit Gamma exactness needed for arbitrary free presentations; finite-cover colimits justify arbitrary direct sums and the unit on their cokernel. Singular antidominant parameters remain allowed.

Exact Gamma makes its kernel Serre; unit/counit give the quotient equivalence. Generated torsion-free representatives are proved using maximal sum of kernel subobjects and full faithfulness, without asserting equivalence for the whole singular sheaf category.

Counit kernel/cokernel killed by exactness plus regular conservativity; coherent/finitely generated restrictions use local filtered noetherianity and finite global differential generators. Generalized blocks are not conflated with exact central quotient.

Integral weights from finite composition factors, nilpotent root action on finite weight spans and actual B=T semidirect U BCH supplier integrate compatibly over finite sums/direct union. Strong B-equivariance and exact central annihilation match both directions; full generalized-character block remains excluded.

Morita untwisting, order-one kernel generators and regular conservativity prove absolute kernel form. Central arbitrary base rings and commuting differential operators are separately handled. Relative coherent recovery uses finite differential coefficients; product TDO gluing respects chain rule.

Actual relative rank-one supplier gives higher-image vanishing and both kernel directions, with ordinary differential inverse image and coherent recovered partial-TDO N. No O-coherence assumption on M substitutes for differential coherence.

Local associated sheaves are exact even for rational infinite-dimensional H; beta-minus-gamma gives correctly typed differential action/isotropy. Finite tensor action cancels to horizontal V; parabolic pullback is ordinary inverse image then integral rho action shift.

Full zero-root-subsystem J condition retained for complex weights. Reduced word gives PBW-injective Verma embeddings; quotient root actions integrate to the minimal parabolic on bounded degree spaces. Central projector and Hopf tensor identity prove finite global generation of final bundle, including empty word.

Full zero-root condition and fixed root sequence retained. Filtration implies vanishing by exactness; translate to regular kappa-rho, quotient the fixed globally generated Verma chain and take image to get converse. Empty J forces zero kernel object, not an omitted case.
For c>=1 the nonzero O(-c-1) has H0=0 and H1=C^c. Module-derived comparison supports the nonexactness boundary; regularity without antidominance is not enough.
Explicit chart operators glue by z^d transition, satisfy sl2 brackets and realize d=-c-1; c=-1 gives ordinary D, while c=0 remains nonzero singular D0.
Twist0→rho sends O(-1)→O(-2), changes Casimir -1/2→0 and retains H0=0,H1=C. No preservation of Gamma faithfulness by line twist is asserted.
Weyl quotient by z has derivative basis; delta highest weight c-1 gives the stated Verma and Casimir (c²-1)/2 with exact center. Compatible with TDO sign convention.
Nonzero O(-1) at kappa=0 has both cohomology groups zero and lies in the point parabolic kernel. This refutes conservativity while preserving antidominant exactness.

V(nrho) has exact character chi_(n+1)rho and regular antidominant representative -(n+1)rho, including n=0 trivial rep. Category O corollary applies to exact annihilation, not entire generalized block.
